title: Answer explains the newton as a unit of force
query: What is one newton of force?
answer: One newton is the net force that gives a 1 kg mass an acceleration of 1 m/s^2, so 1 N = 1 kg m/s^2.

answer: Average acceleration is the change in velocity divided by the time taken: a = (v_final - v_initial) / t. For example, going from 2 m/s to 8 m/s in 3 s gives 2 m/s^2.
